paite: Huan huang sungnungzaw malam pang ah ahon pikhia a; mun awng zawn mallam kulh khuam doh dantan ah hon pilut hi.
heading: Tempul Kiang A Inn Nih

paite: Mallam pang a dantante tong za a sau tong sawmnga a za ahi.
Huang sungnungzaw pen mun awng tong sawmnih lam nga leh huang ponungzaw suanglep lam doh inchial thum a-om tuaktuak hi.
Dantante kikal ah tong sawm a za, tong za a sau paisuakna a-om a, akongkhakte'n mallam anga hi.
Dantan tungnungte akochikzaw a; inchial nuainungzaw leh alaitate sang in a-inchialte'n mun lian aluah zaw uhi.
Chial thum a lam ahi a, huangsung khuamte bang in khuam anei kei a; huchi in alaita sang in atungnungpen akochikzaw a, alaita leng anuainungpen sang in akochikzaw lai hi.
Huan dantan pang polam ah huangsung ponungzaw pen lam doh baang tong sawmnga a sau a-om hi.
Huangsung ponungzaw a dantante tong sawmnga a sau ahi ua; tempul zul a pen tong za a sau ahi.
Huan huai dantante nuai ah suahlam pang ah huangsung ponungzaw a kipan polam ah alutna a-om hi.
Simlam ah leng mun awng zawn a kulhbaang doh in dantante a-om nawn hi.
Ama a paina leng mallam dantante paina mah bang ahi a; adung leh avai leng, apawtkhiaknate, alepkhawmdante, akongkhakte'n simlam anga chih kia lou ngal akibang vek ahi.
Huai dantante lutna ding paisuakna tawp suahlam baangchin ah kongkhak a-om hi.

Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Simlam leh mallam dantan, mun awl hon dohte dantan siangthoute ahi ua; thil siangthoute akoihkhawm ua; nek ding latnate, khelh ziak a kithoihnate, moh ziak a kithoihnate alatna ding uh ahi; amun lah asiangthou ngal a.

Huai lai a siampute alut phot uleh, mun siangthou a kipan in huangsung ponungzaw ah apawtkhe ding uh ahi kei; huai ah anasepna puansilhte uh akoih zaw ding ua, puansilh siangthou ahi ngal ua; puansilh dang silh kia in vantang lak ah agamtang thei ding uh," achi hi.
Tempul sungnungzaw pen ateh khit in suahlam nga kongpi ah ahon pikhia a, tempul kimvel in ateh hi.
heading: Tempul Huangsung Tehna

paite: Tehna chiang in suahlam pang ateh a, atehna chiang a teh in tong zanga ahi.
Mallam pang ahon teh nawn leuleu a, atehna chiang a teh in tong zanga ahi.
Simlam pang ateh nawn a, tehna chiang a teh in tong zanga mah ahi.
Huan tumlam ahon teh nawn a, atehna chiang a teh in tong zanga mah ahi.
Apang li in atehta a; adunglam tong zanga, availam tong zanga ahi; akim in kulhbaang nei ahi; huai mun siang leh siang lou deidanna ding a bawl ahi.
